known_defects.defect: short motion span on adjacent hops in tb
known_defects.detail: In tb every adjacent rank pair has a 4-cell gap and the renderer animates only the 2-cell corridor between the stem and the arrowhead, so the dots on e1, e2, e4, e7 (v1) and e3 (v2) advance one cell and wrap every 4 frames (400 ms) instead of travelling. Visible in evidence/v1/v1-frames-77x47.txt frames 0-4 and evidence/v2/v2-frames-77x47.txt frames 0-4.
known_defects.attempted_fix: lr was measured for the same 5-node path: structurally clean (0 bridges, 0 ambiguous) but extent 117x8, which overflows 77 columns, so lr was rejected; see attempts/v1-a3.check.txt and attempts.json.
known_defects.not_hidden: the routes were not switched to dots: 0 and no label was cut; the constant-rate check reports 0 dot violations

known_defects.defect: dots wrap before touching the arrowhead in constant mode
known_defects.detail: In constant mode the renderer loops each dot inside the corridor: the v2 session dot is last drawn at (28,23) and restarts at (27,35) at frame 26 while the drawn head ▼ sits at (29,22). arrivals: 0/0 is therefore reported because no route asks for same-arrival timing; constant mode does not claim arrival.
